Abstract:
Based on Trixnity Messenger, different customization options of the Matrix messenger client are shown to create a new messenger - "Malmy".
We start easy with some white-labelling and re-route some parts of the app.
We continue with some adaptations of the existing UI and by adding a new feature that integrates seamlessly.
Lastly, we explore the possibility to re-use the messenger's UI logic to build a completely new UI layer on top.
